concerns.text: SC-001 requires that the pipeline does not exceed the 7 GB RAM limit, but no task verifies peak memory usage. Add a verification step (e.g., monitor RAM and fail if >7 GB) and record the result.
SC-005 mandates the entire analysis complete within 3600 seconds, yet no task measures total runtime. Introduce a task that records elapsed time for the full pipeline and asserts it ≤ 3600 s.

Constitution I (Reproducibility) requires random seeds to be pinned in code, but there is no task that checks or enforces seed pinning. Add a verification task that scans `code/` for fixed seed settings and fails if absent.
